A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the distribution of words in a large corpus can be used as a reliable indicator of semantic similarity.
our system is able to generate a high quality thesaurus of synonyms and related words automatically.
we provide a new way to generate thesauri that is based on distributional similarities of word co-occurrences and is applicable to many languages.

distributional information can be used to create a thesaurus that is as good as the one produced by humans, and that this thesaurus can be used to improve machine translation.
distributional similarity is a powerful and reliable measure for the automatic compilation of a word similarity thesaurus.
